a.name: Hairline columns
a.description: Five facts side by side as five columns split by vertical hairlines, each a line icon, serif title and one sentence, between two rules.
a.differs_from: Five hairline-split columns framed by rules, no photo; London's pick is a ledger of rows beside Maggie's photo, and the built takeaways are a plain stack, a grid on a band or a rail.

b.name: Label and tiles
b.description: The strip's name in its own column, then five tinted steel-100 tiles, a bold lead and a sentence each, the guarantee tile across both.
b.differs_from: A label cell and five sunk tinted tiles in one grid, no photo; London's pick is ruled rows beside a photo, and the built takeaways sit plain, on a band or in a rail.

c.name: Tick card
c.description: One raised card: Manchester's family photo across the top, title and answer side by side, then five brass ticks in two columns.
c.differs_from: Refresh delta, layout: London's one column of four ticks under a heading becomes a two-column tick grid from 768px under a title and answer set side by side. Differs from London's pick on all four axes.
